podSecurityContext.description:
SecurityContext to use for the Velero deployment. Optional.
Set fsGroup for `AWS IAM Roles for Service Accounts`
see more informations at: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html
fsGroup: 1337

affinity.description: Affinity to use for the Velero deployment. Optional.

annotations.description:
Annotations to add to the Velero deployment's. Optional.
If you are using reloader use the following annotation with your VELERO_SECRET_NAME
secret.reloader.stakater.com/reload: "<VELERO_SECRET_NAME>"

backupsEnabled.description: Whether to create backupstoragelocation crd, if false => do not create a default backup location

cleanUpCRDs.description:
This job is meant primarily for cleaning up CRDs on CI systems.
Using this on production systems, especially those that have multiple releases of Velero, will be destructive.

configMaps.description:
Velero ConfigMaps.
Eg:
configMaps:
See: https://velero.io/docs/v1.11/file-system-backup/
fs-restore-action-config:
labels:
velero.io/plugin-config: ""
velero.io/pod-volume-restore: RestoreItemAction
data:
image: velero/velero:v1.17.1
cpuRequest: 200m
memRequest: 128Mi
cpuLimit: 200m
memLimit: 128Mi
secCtx: |
capabilities:
drop:
- ALL
add: []
allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
runAsUser: 1001
runAsGroup: 999

configuration.description:
Parameters for the `default` BackupStorageLocation and VolumeSnapshotLocation,
and additional server settings.

containerSecurityContext.description:
Container Level Security Context for the 'velero' container of the Velero deployment. Optional.
See: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/#set-the-security-context-for-a-container
allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
capabilities:
drop: ["ALL"]
add: []
readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

credentials.description:
Info about the secret to be used by the Velero deployment, which
should contain credentials for the cloud provider IAM account you've
set up for Velero.

deployNodeAgent.description: Whether to deploy the node-agent daemonset.

dnsConfig.description: DNS configuration to use for the Velero deployment. Optional.

dnsPolicy.description:
Configure the dnsPolicy of the Velero deployment
See: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/#pod-s-dns-policy

extraObjects.description:
Extra K8s manifests to deploy
- apiVersion: secrets-store.csi.x-k8s.io/v1
kind: SecretProviderClass
metadata:
name: velero-secrets-store
spec:
provider: aws
parameters:
objects: |
- objectName: "velero"
objectType: "secretsmanager"
jmesPath:
- path: "access_key"
objectAlias: "access_key"
- path: "secret_key"
objectAlias: "secret_key"
secretObjects:
- data:
- key: access_key
objectName: client-id
- key: client-secret
objectName: client-secret
secretName: velero-secrets-store
type: Opaque

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volumeMounts for the Velero deployment. Optional.

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes for the Velero deployment. Optional.

hostAliases.description:
Configure hostAliases for Velero deployment. Optional
For more information, check: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/network/customize-hosts-file-for-pods/
- ip: "127.0.0.1"
hostnames:
- "foo.local"
- "bar.local"

image.description:
Details of the container image to use in the Velero deployment & daemonset (if
enabling node-agent). Required.

initContainers.description:
Init containers to add to the Velero deployment's pod spec. At least one plugin provider image is required.
If the value is a string then it is evaluated as a template.
- name: velero-plugin-for-aws
image: velero/velero-plugin-for-aws:v1.13.1
imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
volumeMounts:
- mountPath: /target
name: plugins

labels.description: Labels to add to the Velero deployment's. Optional.

lifecycle.description: Container Lifecycle Hooks to use for the Velero deployment. Optional.

metrics.description: Settings for Velero's prometheus metrics. Enabled by default.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector to use for the Velero deployment. Optional.

podAnnotations.description:
Annotations to add to the Velero deployment's pod template. Optional.
If using kube2iam or kiam, use the following annotation with your AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
and VELERO_ROLE_NAME filled in:
iam.amazonaws.com/role: "arn:aws:iam::<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>:role/<VELERO_ROLE_NAME>"

podDisruptionBudget.description:
Pod Disruption Budget for the Velero deployment. Optional.
Velero runs a single replica with a Recreate strategy by default, so this is
disabled by default. Enable it when running Velero with multiple replicas.

podLabels.description:
Additional pod labels for Velero deployment's template. Optional
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/

podSecurityContext.description:
SecurityContext to use for the Velero deployment. Optional.
Set fsGroup for `AWS IAM Roles for Service Accounts`
see more informations at: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html
fsGroup: 1337

priorityClassName.description: Pod priority class name to use for the Velero deployment. Optional.

resizePolicy.description:
Container resize policy for the Velero deployment.
See: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/resize-container-resources/
- resourceName: cpu
restartPolicy: NotRequired
- resourceName: memory
restartPolicy: RestartContainer

resources.description:
Resource requests/limits to specify for the Velero deployment.
https://velero.io/docs/v1.6/customize-installation/#customize-resource-requests-and-limits
requests:
cpu: 500m
memory: 128Mi
limits:
cpu: 1000m
memory: 512Mi

runtimeClassName.description: Pod runtime class name to use for the Velero deployment. Optional.

schedules.description:
Backup schedules to create.
Eg:
schedules:
mybackup:
disabled: false
labels:
myenv: foo
annotations:
myenv: foo
schedule: "0 0 * * *"
useOwnerReferencesInBackup: false
paused: false
skipImmediately: false
template:
ttl: "240h"
storageLocation: default
includedNamespaces:
- foo
See: https://velero.io/docs/v1.14/resource-filtering/#excludes
excludedNamespaceScopedResources:
- persistentVolumeClaims
excludedClusterScopedResources:
- persistentVolumes

serviceAccount.description: Information about the Kubernetes service account Velero uses.

snapshotsEnabled.description: Whether to create volumesnapshotlocation crd, if false => disable snapshot feature

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: The number of seconds to allow for graceful termination of the pod. Optional.

tolerations.description: Tolerations to use for the Velero deployment. Optional.

upgradeCRDsJob.description:
requests:
cpu: 50m
memory: 128Mi
limits:
cpu: 100m
memory: 256Mi

upgradeJobResources.description: Resource requests/limits to specify for the upgradeCRDs job pod. Need to be adjusted by user accordingly.
